sources.eurovoc: EuroVoc thesaurus, Publications Office of the European Union
sources.cellar: CELLAR common repository metadata, Publications Office of the European Union

terms.note: Publications Office metadata and EuroVoc are understood to be reusable under the Commission reuse policy (Decision 2011/833/EU) with attribution. This was not confirmed against an authoritative licence statement during capture; a human maintainer must confirm the terms before the snapshot is redistributed.

living_source_warning: CELLAR and EuroVoc change over time. Re-running the fetcher creates a new snapshot version; the frozen files, not the live endpoint, are the experiment input.
